name: io.github.rashidazarang/airtable-mcp
description: Runs locally: Airtable records, schema, comments, upserts, base/table allow-lists and PII masking

environmentVariables.name: AIRTABLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Airtable personal access token from https://airtable.com/create/tokens. Grant data.records, data.recordComments and schema.bases (read and write) and user.email:read.

environmentVariables.name: AIRTABLE_BASE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default base ID. When set, other bases are refused unless listed in AIRTABLE_ALLOWED_BASES. Leave unset to use every base the token can reach.

environmentVariables.name: AIRTABLE_ALLOWED_BASES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated base IDs the server may use. Unset allows every base the token can reach.

environmentVariables.name: AIRTABLE_ALLOWED_TABLES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated baseId:tableName pairs. In a base listed here, only the listed tables are allowed.

environmentVariables.name: AIRTABLE_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: Tools to register: full (all tools), core (18 record tools, for clients that cap enabled tools) or a comma-separated list of tool names.

environmentVariables.name: AIRTABLE_GOVERNANCE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a governance JSON file (allow-lists, allowed operations, PII field policies). Defaults to config/governance.json in the working directory, if present.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level. Logs go to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: EXCEPTION_QUEUE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: How many recent errors the list_exceptions tool keeps.
